prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Dallas for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” dentist for every implant case. If you want a **starting point in Dallas**, consider **The Dental Implant Center**, led by Dr. David McFadden, a board-certified prosthodontist. Prosthodontists specialize in replacing and restoring teeth, and the practice says it also has two other prosthodontists. [Practice details](https://www.dentalimplantcenter.com/our-practice/)

For the **surgical placement**, you may also want a consultation with a board-certified periodontist, such as **Dr. Laura Rabe** at Dallas Periodontics and Dental Implants or **Dr. Mark Glover**. Periodontists receive specialist training in gum and bone health and implant surgery. [Rabe’s practice](https://www.periodallas.com/about-us/meet-our-doctors/) · [Glover’s practice](https://markgloverdds.com/)

Before choosing, ask who will place the implant and who will make the crown, how often they handle cases like yours, whether you need bone grafting, and for a written estimate covering the full treatment. A second opinion is especially worthwhile for full-mouth work or a complex case.
